features.title: Installable Knowledge owns all seven vault tabs through Echo's native engine
Pages, search, graph and conflict-safe editing retain existing behavior
Existing Knowledge links and registry remain usable
Minutes exports preserve receipts, idempotence and user edits
Ask, Curate and Research retain native profile and permission guards
Ingest and Health retain scratch isolation, review and validated evidence
Disable, enable and removal clean up the plugin and preserve vault data
Native Knowledge access requires its declared capability and enabled plugin
